entryListPane.heading: Entries
entryListPane.loadFailed: Unable to load entries. Close the app and try again.

entryDetailPane.heading: Entry details
entryDetailPane.empty: Select an entry to see its details
entryDetailPane.loadFailed: Unable to load the details of this entry.

entryTotp.progressLabel: Time left until the code changes
entryTotp.loadFailed: Unable to load the verification code.

entryCreate.title: New entry
entryCreate.description: The name is required. Everything else can stay empty. A custom field you add needs a field name.

typeStep.title: Choose an entry type
typeStep.description: Pick a type first. The form shows the fields of that type.

totp.label: TOTP secret or link
totp.description: Paste a Base32 secret or an otpauth link. You can also paste a QR code screenshot here.

status.read: QR code read. It takes effect when you save.
status.unreadable: No QR code found. Try a clearer image.
status.notTotp: This QR code does not contain a usable TOTP link.
status.tooLarge: The image is too large. Choose one under {maxSize} MB.
status.failed: Reading the QR code failed. Try again.

error.totpInvalid: The TOTP secret or link is not valid. Check it and try again.
error.totpUnsupported: This link is not supported. Supported: TOTP type, SHA1, SHA256 or SHA512, 6 or 8 digits, a period of 1 to {maxPeriod} seconds.
error.nameTooLong: The name can have at most {maxLength} characters.
error.invalid: The content is not valid. Check it and try again.
error.unexpected: Saving failed. Close the app and try again.

onboarding.title: Set a master password
onboarding.description: The master password unlocks your data each time you open the app.
onboarding.forgetNotice: The master password is not stored. If you forget it, it cannot be recovered and your data cannot be opened.

error.tooShort: The master password needs at least {minLength} characters.
error.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
error.systemUnavailable: The system cannot protect the data key, so you cannot skip. Set a master password.
error.unexpected: The operation failed. Close the app and try again.

skipConfirm.title: Skip the master password?
skipConfirm.description: Your data stays encrypted, but anyone who can sign in to this Windows account can open the app.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.description: Enter your master password to open your data.

error.wrongPassword: The master password is incorrect. Try again.
error.unexpected: Unlock failed. Close the app and try again.

failure.title: Unable to open your data
failure.description: A data file is missing or damaged, or the system cannot open the protected key. Close the app and try again. Do not delete the vault folder in the data directory.
